name: Firstbase
description: Firstbase provides business incorporation, registered-agent and compliance services, virtual mail, accounting, tax filing, banking introductions, and startup operations.
agentUseSummary: Firstbase cannot currently be connected as a Relay agent provider. Firstbase advertises an incorporation Referral API only through an application-based enterprise partner program with private documentation, and publishes no public authentication contract, stable schemas, scopes, revocation, sandbox, or bounded account-read surface. Relay will not invent private API calls, submit incorporation or tax workflows, reuse dashboard sessions, or treat customer-configured Plaid, Stripe, banking, or partner integrations as Firstbase authority.

blocked.label: Connect a Firstbase account
blocked.description: Firstbase publishes no supported public OAuth, account API key, remote MCP, or other delegated customer-account contract for Relay to implement.

blocked.label: Use the private partner API
blocked.description: The Referral API requires an approved enterprise partnership and private documentation; Relay has no authorization to infer credentials, endpoints, schemas, quotas, or partner terms.

blocked.label: Perform legal or financial actions
blocked.description: Incorporations, state and IRS filings, EIN applications, tax returns, compliance filings, registered-agent changes, mail handling, banking applications, accounting imports, payments, and other consequential actions are blocked.

blocked.label: Use unsupported automation
blocked.description: Relay will not automate the dashboard, reuse browser sessions, capture identity or financial credentials, scrape records, reverse-engineer private APIs, or relabel Plaid, Stripe, banking, Carta, affiliate, or reseller workflows as public Firstbase authority.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No agent actions can be enabled without an approved Firstbase partner contract and supported distributable API with stable schemas and least-privilege authorization.

runtimeSupport.description: No publicly documented customer-authenticated Firstbase operation is available to mount as OpenClaw tools.
No publicly documented customer-authenticated Firstbase operation is available to mount as Hermes tools.

providerSetup.blocker: Firstbase advertises an incorporation Referral API only to approved API partners and says API documentation is included after applying. The public materials do not expose authentication, endpoint schemas, scopes, revocation, sandbox behavior, quotas, or a bounded customer-account read contract. The advertised purpose is to offer incorporation directly to a partner's customers, which is a consequential legal workflow rather than a safe metadata read.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not expose Connect, request Firstbase or financial credentials, publish runtime tools, call guessed partner endpoints, or automate the dashboard. Reconsider only after Firstbase explicitly approves Relay, supplies the current written partner contract and stable API schemas, and a human owner defines bounded authority, credential lifecycle, sandbox acceptance, audit requirements, and legal-action confirmations.

evidence.supports: Firstbase advertises a Referral API for API and Loop partners to offer incorporation directly to customers, but requires an application and describes API documentation as a partner benefit. The public page supplies no authentication, endpoints, scopes, revocation, sandbox, or stable schemas.

Firstbase documents that incorporation requires business and owner information, payment, state filings, registered-agent and address requirements, shareholder or owner addresses, signed IRS forms, EIN processing, identity documents, and banking applications. Relay treats these as consequential legal and identity workflows, not autonomous default actions.

Firstbase documents customer-driven Plaid bank/credit-card linking and Stripe connection inside its Accounting dashboard. Those third-party interactive connections do not provide Relay with a public Firstbase account API or reusable customer authority.
